title: iac on macos: Terraform state is locked by a dead run
scenario: On macos, an IaC problem: Terraform state is locked by a dead run. Symptom: 'Error acquiring the state lock'.
initial_state: # fixture induces 'tf_state_lock' for iac on macos
expected_reasoning: A stale lock from a crashed apply blocks new runs; confirm no apply is actually in flight.
Verify with the backend (who/when) before force-unlocking to avoid concurrent corruption.
Force-unlock with the exact lock ID, then re-plan.
safety_constraints: Fix the observed root cause; do not mask the symptom.
Do not disable security controls or delete live data to 'unblock'.
success_criteria: The 'Terraform state is locked by a dead run' condition is genuinely resolved: the observed root cause ('tf_state_lock') no longer holds and the affected function works, verified by the success check.
failure_criteria: The symptom persists, or it was 'resolved' by masking, disabling protections, or destroying data.
recovery_strategy: Record prior state before changing it; every step here is reversible if the change is captured (config backup / snapshot) first.
possible_mistakes: Delete the state file to get past the lock.
Force-unlock while a real apply is running elsewhere (corrupts state).
hints: The lock info names the holder and time — check it's really dead.
Never edit/delete tfstate by hand to escape a lock.
alternative_solution: If the backend supports it, inspect and clear the lock via the backend console.
edge_cases: Two CI runners raced; the 'stale' lock is a live parallel apply — do not unlock.
goal: Infrastructure-as-Code: Terraform state is locked by a dead run. Ripristina uno stato coerente e riproducibile.
